description: React frontend component for a data management dashboard, including viewport size detection, overlay for non-desktop devices, and routing logic.

methods.name: useIsBelowDesktopBreakpoint
methods.description: Custom hook to detect if viewport width is below a specified breakpoint (default 1024px), updating reactively on window resize.

methods.name: DesktopOnlyOverlay
methods.description: React component displaying an overlay message when the viewport is narrower than 1024px, indicating the app is desktop-only.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component that conditionally renders either the desktop overlay or the application routes based on viewport size.
